question.text: Audit trail requirement in PMS means each trade decision must have:

answer.text: Timestamp + rationale + approval + execution details — reconstructible trail

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Full audit trail: who decided, when, why, approvals, execution path. Reconstructible on SEBI inspection. **The Trap:** Partial records fail audit. **Cross-Exam Context:** Core PM Regs. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Use OMS that captures every field automatically — avoid manual reconstruction later.
